extracted.name: Boiled Peanuts
extracted.description: Boiled peanuts, cooked in salt water until soft and juicy, are a Southern staple and make a tasty, savory snack that will be an instant favorite.
instruction_lines: Wash peanuts and place them in a pot. Add salt, then water to cover. Bring water to a boil.
Let peanuts boil in water for at least 3 hours.
After three hours, take out a peanut and try it – if it’s not soft enough, keep boiling until the desired softness is reached.
